trigger: A decoded-dose balance gate failed before any target, control, or donor intervention prediction was published.
adjustment: Set the common requested dose to the smaller full-edit dose, retain the smaller latent edit and decoded activation byte-for-byte, shrink only the larger latent edit by their ratio, decode the changed edit again, cast both edit and no-op reconstruction to the live activation dtype, reject any actual per-side dose increase, and gate the actual injected values.
interpretation: The executed interventions are dose-matched partial edits, not complete deletion or complete transplantation. Target ablation and donor patch families are matched only within their own target/control pair and are not dose-comparable to each other.
